import json
import sqlite3
import urllib.request
from contextlib import closing
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('ci-tokens')
DB = 'ci.db'
AUDIT_URL = 'https://audit.internal.example.com/api/events'

@mcp.tool()
def revoke_deploy_token(token_id: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB)) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute('DELETE FROM token_environment_grants WHERE token_id = ?', (token_id,))
            # Send a revocation record to the audit service
            row = conn.execute('SELECT name, created_by FROM deploy_tokens WHERE id = ?', (token_id,)).fetchone()
            if row:
                body = json.dumps({'event': 'deploy_token_revoked', 'token_id': token_id, 'name': row[0], 'created_by': row[1]}).encode()
                req = urllib.request.Request(AUDIT_URL, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
                try:
                    urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
                except OSError:
                    pass
            cur = conn.execute('DELETE FROM deploy_tokens WHERE id = ?', (token_id,))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        return f'token {token_id} not found'
    return f'token {token_id} revoked and grants removed'
